name: roblox-studio-company
description: A complete Roblox game studio in your AI assistant.

interface.shortDescription: Your own Roblox game studio: design, build, test, launch, operate.
interface.longDescription: A Studio Manager who reports to you and ten departments (production, design, engineering, art, tech art, audio, QA, live-ops, publishing, research), each in its own folder. Interviews you for genre and story, then designs, builds in Luau with Rojo, tests, launches with your approval and runs the game, using open-source tools.
defaultPrompt: Start the studio: let us make a Roblox game.
Studio, give me a status report.
Balance our game economy and show me the report.
